ru.Ci sono luoghi che non si visitano solta: Есть места, в которых не просто бывают. Ими живут, ими дышат, и они остаются в душе.
ru.Nel cuore della Riviera dei Cedri, sulla: В самом сердце Ривьеры-деи-Чедри, на тирренском побережье Калабрии, открывается удивительный край, где глубокая синева моря встречается с зеленью гор, где природа ещё хранит нетронутые уголки, а старинные городки — многовековую историю, культуру и традиции.
ru.Qui il paesaggio cambia continuamente: s: Здесь пейзаж постоянно меняется: залитые солнцем пляжи, скалы, обточенные морем, укромные бухты, кристально чистая вода и старинные кварталы с видом на Средиземное море.
ru.Da Scalea si può partire alla scoperta d: Из Скалеа можно отправиться навстречу одним из самых впечатляющих пейзажей юга Италии.
ru.La suggestiva Torre Talao, simbolo della: Живописная башня Талао, символ нашего города, возвышается над морем и напоминает о давней связи Скалеа со Средиземноморьем.
ru.Poco distante, l’Arcomagno di San Nicola: Неподалёку Аркоманьо в Сан-Никола-Арчелла поражает своей величественной природной аркой, а остров Дино у Прая-а-Маре открывает морские пейзажи редкой красоты.
ru.L’Isola di Cirella, i borghi di Diamante: Остров Чирелла, городки Диаманте и Айета, горы Поллино и долина реки Лао дополняют этот необычайно разнообразный пейзаж.
ru.È una Calabria da esplorare lentamente,: Эту Калабрию стоит открывать неспешно, позволяя ей удивлять своей природой, кухней, гостеприимством и подлинностью.
ru.Qui il mare assume mille sfumature di bl: Здесь море переливается тысячами синих и бирюзовых оттенков. На побережье протяжённые пляжи сменяются небольшими бухтами и скалами, а в глубине края леса, горы и реки дарят настоящее единение с природой.
ru.È una terra che invita a rallentare, a r: Эта земля приглашает замедлить шаг, вновь открыть радость простых вещей и позволить себе проживать каждое мгновение.
ru.È proprio qui, a Scalea, che nasce e viv: Именно здесь, в Скалеа, родился и живёт ZITO1950®.
ru.Vogliamo che il nostro marchio sia anche: Мы хотим, чтобы наша марка стала ещё и приглашением познакомиться с Калабрией, открыть её места, традиции и чудеса.
ru.Per questo le porte della nostra casa so: Поэтому двери нашего дома открыты для всех, кто хочет встретиться с нами, поближе познакомиться с нашими творениями и разделить любовь к прекрасному и ко времени.
ru.Che tu arrivi dall’Italia o da qualsiasi: Откуда бы вы ни приехали — из Италии или из любой другой страны мира, — мы будем вам рады.
Ждём вас в Скалеа, в Калабрии.

en.Un piccolo negozio le cui vetrine mostra: A small shop whose windows display few but precious watches, arranged in little groups; at the back, a homely atmosphere: comfortable armchairs to sit in, chat and enjoy sweets made by my grandmother, as was typical of the shops of the time… where time passed slowly.
en.Verso la fine degli anni Cinquanta è Fra: In the late 1950s it is Francesco Zito, my father and a skilled watchmaker, who takes on the task of guiding the family business towards the new millennium.
en.E ci riesce benissimo con geniali intuiz: And he does so brilliantly, with inspired ideas that remain cornerstones of ZITO1950® today.
en.Nel 1970 apre lo showroom creato da un f: In 1970 he opens the showroom designed by a famous architect from Siena and, among many creations, patents a highly successful yellow gold pendant. A story, surprising in some ways, that sparked my greatest passion: watches!
en.Francesco Zito in giacca e cravatta sedu: Francesco Zito in jacket and tie sitting on a scooter, black-and-white photo
en.Col passare del tempo, le mode impongono: Over time, fashions set new standards, and mechanical timepieces rightly remain the exclusive desire of connoisseurs.
en.Nuovi materiali vengono utilizzati all'i: New materials find their way inside the watch: in the 1960s some brands fitted a plastic escapement into a metal movement, colouring the parts to make them stand out even more. So began the "modern" era, in which the balance was driven electronically by a large battery, leading a few decades ago to the quartz movement.
en.Qualcuno dice, però, che la differenza f: Some say, however, that the difference between a mechanical watch and a quartz one is the same as that between an oil portrait and a passport photo.
en.Francesco Zito al banco da orologiaio, s: Francesco Zito at the watchmaker's bench, in the background the ZITO1950® sign

en.Vittorio Zito su Ducati Marianna 125 195: Vittorio Zito on a Ducati Marianna 125, 1957 – (Photo Breveglieri)
en.Da bambino, spesso seduto accanto a mio: As a child, often sitting beside my grandfather in his workshop, I spent hours watching him remake watch parts on the lathe, feeding my already boundless curiosity!
en.Inizia dunque una nuova era, caratterizz: So a new era begins, shaped by the vision of Luigi Antonio Zito, the founder's grandson: to pass his passion on to customers through creations that meet their needs, such as never giving up an accessory that is at times elegant, at times casual, at times unique. In a globalised market, where so much seems to conform to the same rules, following fashion is no longer enough: you have to set it. In other words, you must be able to innovate and be original.
en.Una storia che abbiamo voluto concretizz: A story we have brought to life today in two forms: one to wear on the wrist, reliable and full of character, the other to keep in the pocket or on the writing desk.
en.Luigi Antonio Zito alla scrivania mentre: Luigi Antonio Zito at his desk drawing a watch, surrounded by templates and watches, black-and-white photo
en.Il tempo fugge e l'orologio non ha il po: Time flies, and a watch has no power to stop it; it only reminds us that the past no longer exists and that life must be lived in the exact second shown on the dial.
en.L'orologio era per me, allo stesso tempo: To me, a watch was both a marvellous instrument and a faithful companion. The first beat, the first "tick", was a unique experience, like the beginning of a new life.
en.Non si è mai completamente vestiti senza: You are never fully dressed without perfume!
en.Selvaggio, primitivo e misterioso, l'oud: Wild, primal and mysterious, oud, also known as agarwood, is even mentioned in the Bible, in the Song of Songs. Few scents in the world can boast such noble and ancient origins.
en.L’oud, noto anche come Agarwood, è il pr: Oud, also known as agarwood, is the scent par excellence of the Middle East: Gulf elites pay astronomical sums for small vials of this oil, just a few drops of which release an intense fragrance.
en.E pensare che invece l’oud è originario: Yet oud actually originates in Southeast Asia. This resin is one of nature's most curious creations: an aromatic exudate that Aquilaria trees produce to protect themselves from moulds, fungi or insects attacking their bark.

en.La nostra storia è fatta di orologi. La: Our story is made of watches. Our reputation is built over time.
en.Non è soltanto una questione di tempo. È: It is not simply a matter of time. It is a matter of identity.
en.Ci sono cose che non si possono misurare: There are things no watch can measure: passion, the courage to dream, the determination to bring a project to life, the value of a promise kept.
ZITO1950® was born of this vision.
en.Siamo espressione di una cultura del far: We embody a culture of craftsmanship rooted in southern Italy, a land of ancient civilisations, art, beauty and tradition. A land that carries the legacy of Magna Graecia, where harmony of form, the pursuit of beauty and an appreciation of art have left an extraordinary heritage.
en.È questa sensibilità che ispira il nostr: It is this sensibility that inspires our approach to watchmaking.
en.Crediamo che ogni progetto importante na: We believe that every meaningful endeavour begins with genuine passion. The same passion drives us to research, design and select every element of our creations.
en.La qualità si riconosce soprattutto nei: Quality reveals itself above all in the details. We devote care to proportions, finishes, materials, dials and every single component. Because it is the details that turn an object into something special.
en.Lo stile non è seguire una moda. È avere: Style is not about following fashion. It is about having an identity of your own. Our creations bring classical elegance, sporting character and contemporary sensibility into dialogue, with a distinctive personality.
en.Portiamo nei nostri orologi qualcosa del: We bring something of our homeland to our watches: its warmth, creativity, sense of beauty, respect for tradition and that natural instinct to give everything character. Calabria is not just where we come from: it is part of our inspiration.
en.Crediamo nella serietà, nella lealtà e n: We believe in integrity, loyalty and honouring our commitments. A promise still means something. It is a simple but fundamental principle that guides our relationship with everyone who chooses ZITO1950®.
en.Ogni nuova idea richiede coraggio. Credi: Every new idea takes courage. We believe in independent thinking, creative freedom and the ability to follow our own path without losing our identity.
en.Guardiamo avanti con curiosità e lungimi: We look ahead with curiosity and foresight. Every project begins with a dream, but takes shape through research, expertise, dedication and the determination to make it happen.
en.Scegliere ZITO1950® significa riconoscer: To choose ZITO1950® is to find a reflection of your own way of thinking and living.
en.Significa apprezzare la bellezza delle c: It means appreciating the beauty of things well made, respecting tradition without forgoing innovation, and believing that even a dream born in a land far from the great centres of industry can become something extraordinary.
en.Perché dalla Calabria, terra di antiche: Because Calabria, a land of ancient civilisations and a rich artistic culture, continues to give rise to ideas, projects and wonderful things.
en.Calabria. Una terra da vivere, una belle: Calabria. A land to experience, a beauty to discover.
en.Ci sono luoghi che non si visitano solta: Some places are more than somewhere to visit. You experience them, breathe them in, and they stay with you.
en.Nel cuore della Riviera dei Cedri, sulla: In the heart of the Riviera dei Cedri, on Calabria’s Tyrrhenian coast, an extraordinary landscape unfolds, where the deep blue of the sea meets the green of the mountains, where nature still preserves unspoilt corners and historic towns hold centuries of history, culture and tradition.
en.Qui il paesaggio cambia continuamente: s: Here the landscape is ever-changing: sunlit beaches, cliffs shaped by the sea, hidden bays, crystal-clear waters and historic old towns overlooking the Mediterranean.
en.Da Scalea si può partire alla scoperta d: From Scalea, you can set out to discover some of the most captivating scenery in southern Italy.
en.La suggestiva Torre Talao, simbolo della: The striking Torre Talao, a symbol of our town, overlooks the sea and tells the story of Scalea’s ancient bond with the Mediterranean.
en.Poco distante, l’Arcomagno di San Nicola: Nearby, the Arcomagno at San Nicola Arcella amazes with its spectacular natural arch, while Dino Island, at Praia a Mare, offers seascapes of rare beauty.
en.L’Isola di Cirella, i borghi di Diamante: Cirella Island, the towns of Diamante and Aieta, the Pollino mountains and the Lao River valley complete a landscape of extraordinary variety.
en.È una Calabria da esplorare lentamente,: This is a Calabria to explore slowly, letting yourself be surprised by its nature, food, hospitality and authenticity.
en.Qui il mare assume mille sfumature di bl: Here the sea takes on a thousand shades of blue and turquoise. Along the coast, long beaches alternate with small coves and cliffs, while inland, forests, mountains and rivers offer a genuine connection with nature.
en.È una terra che invita a rallentare, a r: It is a land that invites you to slow down, rediscover the pleasure of simple things and give yourself time to savour every moment.
en.È proprio qui, a Scalea, che nasce e viv: It is right here, in Scalea, that ZITO1950® was born and has its home.
en.Vogliamo che il nostro marchio sia anche: We want our brand to be an invitation to get to know Calabria, to discover its places, traditions and wonders.
en.Per questo le porte della nostra casa so: That is why our doors are open to anyone who would like to meet us, see our creations up close and share our passion for beauty and time.
en.Che tu arrivi dall’Italia o da qualsiasi: Whether you come from Italy or anywhere else in the world, you will be welcome.
We look forward to welcoming you to Scalea, Calabria.
en.Una terra meravigliosa. Una casa da scop: A wonderful land. A home to discover. A story to experience.
en.Il tempo passa. I luoghi del cuore riman: Time passes. The places we love remain.

de.Crediamo nella serietà, nella lealtà e n: Wir glauben an Verlässlichkeit, Aufrichtigkeit und daran, Zusagen einzuhalten. Ein gegebenes Wort hat für uns noch Gewicht. Dieser einfache, aber grundlegende Wert prägt unsere Beziehung zu den Menschen, die sich für ZITO1950® entscheiden.

de.Ci sono luoghi che non si visitano solta: Es gibt Orte, die man nicht nur besucht. Man erlebt sie, atmet sie ein und trägt sie in sich weiter.

de.Qui il paesaggio cambia continuamente: s: Hier zeigt sich die Landschaft immer wieder neu: helle Strände, vom Meer geformte Felsen, verborgene Buchten, kristallklares Wasser und alte Ortskerne mit Blick auf das Mittelmeer.

de.È una terra che invita a rallentare, a r: Es ist ein Land, das dazu einlädt, langsamer zu werden, die Freude an den einfachen Dingen wiederzuentdecken und sich die Zeit zu nehmen, jeden Augenblick zu erleben.

pl.Un piccolo negozio le cui vetrine mostra: Mały sklep, w którego witrynach leży niewiele, ale cennych zegarków, ułożonych w małe grupy; w głębi rodzinna atmosfera: wygodne fotele, by usiąść, porozmawiać i skosztować słodkości upieczonych przez moją babcię, jak bywało w sklepach tamtych czasów… gdzie czas płynął powoli.

pl.Nel 1970 apre lo showroom creato da un f: W 1970 roku otwiera salon zaprojektowany przez znanego architekta ze Sieny i wśród wielu swoich dzieł patentuje bardzo udany wisiorek z żółtego złota. Historia pod wieloma względami zaskakująca, od której zaczyna się moja największa pasja: zegarki!

pl.Col passare del tempo, le mode impongono: Z czasem moda narzuca nowe standardy, a zegarki mechaniczne słusznie pozostają przedmiotem pożądania koneserów.
pl.Nuovi materiali vengono utilizzati all'i: Wewnątrz zegarków pojawiają się nowe materiały: w latach 60. niektóre marki umieszczają plastikowy wychwyt w metalowym mechanizmie i barwią części, by jeszcze bardziej je wyróżnić. Tak zaczyna się era „nowoczesna”, w której balans napędzany jest elektronicznie przez dużą baterię, aż kilkadziesiąt lat temu pojawia się mechanizm kwarcowy.
pl.Qualcuno dice, però, che la differenza f: Niektórzy jednak twierdzą, że różnica między zegarkiem mechanicznym a kwarcowym jest taka sama, jak między portretem olejnym a zdjęciem paszportowym.

pl.Da bambino, spesso seduto accanto a mio: Jako dziecko często siedziałem obok dziadka w jego warsztacie i godzinami patrzyłem, jak toczy na tokarce części zegarków – to jeszcze bardziej rozpalało moją i tak bezgraniczną ciekawość!
pl.Inizia dunque una nuova era, caratterizz: Tak zaczyna się nowa era, wyznaczona ideą wnuka, Luigi Antonio Zito: przekazywać pasję klientom poprzez kreacje odpowiadające ich pragnieniom, na przykład by nie rezygnować z dodatku, który bywa elegancki, swobodny albo wyjątkowy. Na zglobalizowanym rynku, gdzie wiele podlega tym samym regułom, nie wystarczy już podążać za modą – trzeba ją tworzyć. Innymi słowy, trzeba umieć wprowadzać innowacje i być oryginalnym.
pl.Una storia che abbiamo voluto concretizz: Historia, którą dziś urzeczywistniliśmy w dwóch formach: jedną do noszenia na nadgarstku, niezawodną i z charakterem, drugą do trzymania w kieszeni lub na biurku.

pl.Il tempo fugge e l'orologio non ha il po: Czas ucieka, a zegarek nie ma mocy, by go zatrzymać: przypomina tylko, że tego, co było, już nie ma, a życie trzeba przeżywać w tej sekundzie, którą wskazuje tarcza.
pl.L'orologio era per me, allo stesso tempo: Zegarek był dla mnie jednocześnie wspaniałym instrumentem i wiernym towarzyszem. Pierwsze uderzenie, pierwsze „tik” było wyjątkowym przeżyciem, jak początek nowego życia.

pl.Crediamo che ogni progetto importante na: Wierzymy, że każdy ważny projekt rodzi się z autentycznej pasji. To ta sama pasja skłania nas do poszukiwań, projektowania i wyboru każdego elementu naszych dzieł.

pl.Crediamo nella serietà, nella lealtà e n: Wierzymy w rzetelność, lojalność i dotrzymywanie zobowiązań. Dane słowo wciąż ma wartość. Ta prosta, lecz fundamentalna zasada wyznacza nasze relacje z tymi, którzy wybierają ZITO1950®.
pl.Ogni nuova idea richiede coraggio. Credi: Każda nowa idea wymaga odwagi. Wierzymy w niezależność myślenia, swobodę twórczą i umiejętność podążania własną drogą bez rezygnacji z naszej tożsamości.

pl.Nel cuore della Riviera dei Cedri, sulla: W sercu Riviera dei Cedri, na tyrreńskim wybrzeżu Kalabrii, rozciąga się niezwykła kraina, gdzie głęboki błękit morza spotyka zieleń gór, przyroda wciąż skrywa dziewicze zakątki, a miasteczka strzegą wielowiekowej historii, kultury i tradycji.

pl.È una Calabria da esplorare lentamente,: To Kalabria, którą warto odkrywać niespiesznie, pozwalając się zaskoczyć jej przyrodzie, kuchni, gościnności i autentyczności.
